notes: Ye shall have is read under rule 43: יִהְיֶה takes have, לָכֶם goes unrepresented, and the suffix takes Ye.
The for before him that is home born is given to that phrase's substantival article, the nominal having no preposition of its own; the parallel וְלַגֵּר writes its own lamed.
aught supplies an object the participle does not write and is added (rules 44, 30).
